statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-70175 (GHSA-x3vp-85cm-q97r) is an ASP.NET Core elevation of privilege issue in ASP.NET Core Identity: password-reset and confirmation flows can send mail to the address supplied in the request instead of the user's stored address. Microsoft's original advisory lists the ASP.NET Core 10.0 runtime packs, including linux-musl-x64 and linux-musl-arm64, as affected from 10.0.0 through 10.0.12 and fixed in 10.0.13. Its November update adds the Identity UI and Blazor template code shipped in the .NET SDK, listing .NET SDK 10.0.100 through 10.0.114 as affected and 10.0.115 as fixed for the 10.0.1xx feature band, and notes that application code generated from earlier templates must be repaired separately (https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/security/advisories/GHSA-x3vp-85cm-q97r, https://github.com/dotnet/announcements/issues/457, https://github.com/dotnet/core/blob/main/release-notes/10.0/10.0.13/10.0.13.md, https://github.com/dotnet/core/blob/main/release-notes/10.0/10.0.15/10.0.15.md). DHI dotnet10-runtime for Alpine 3.23 builds .NET 10 for Linux from Microsoft's source release, and each build's version is the .NET runtime version it carries. Scanned all 264 packages of the twelve published builds (10.0.2-r0, 10.0.3-r0, 10.0.4-r0, 10.0.5-r0, 10.0.6-r0, 10.0.7-r0, 10.0.8-r0, 10.0.9-r0, 10.0.10-r0, 10.0.13-r0, 10.0.14-r0 and 10.0.15-r0) for x86_64 and aarch64, including the files inside the nupkg and other zip archives they hold: every build ships Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity.dll at its own .NET version, in the ASP.NET Core shared framework of aspnetcore10-runtime and of the .NET SDK held by dotnet10-runtime-bootstrap, and in the ASP.NET Core runtime pack and runtime archive held by dotnet10-runtime-bootstrap, plus reference assemblies with no implementation code, and the .NET SDK held by dotnet10-runtime-bootstrap is 10.0.1NN in build 10.0.NN-r0. So 10.0.2-r0 to 10.0.10-r0 carry the unfixed Identity runtime, and 10.0.13-r0 and 10.0.14-r0 carry SDKs 10.0.113 and 10.0.114, which the November update lists as affected. The range ends at 10.0.15-r0 because it is the first published build whose runtime and SDK both carry the fix.
